shared_elements: dense field of small script-like signs arranged in rows/columns
carved relief on an upright slab/stela format
human figure(s) rendered in schematic relief (A clearly; B possibly within glyph blocks)
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing a dense array of small pictorial signs organized in regular rows, which is the only substantive shared feature; A additionally shows a specific figural scene of two seated figures facing each other across an offering table above two horizontal lines of signs, with no counterpart in B. B is entirely covered by rectilinear sign blocks in vertical columns with rounded, deeply modelled internal detail, whereas A uses thin incised outlines and clear registers separating figures from text, so the depictive conventions differ markedly.
